prompt: Loose watercolor and pen sketch inside [LOCATION / SUBJECT], seen from [VIEWPOINT] toward [ARCHITECTURAL FOCAL POINT], [CENTRAL FEATURE] at center, [OVERHEAD ARCHITECTURAL FEATURE] overhead. Ink line drawn first and left visible through every wash — [ARCHITECTURAL LINEWORK] and [GROUND / FLOOR GRID] overshooting into blank paper, one long confident arc for [MAJOR CURVE]. Wash about 65%, warm below and cool above: [WARM ARCHITECTURAL PALETTE] on [LOWER ARCHITECTURAL ELEMENTS], [COOL PALETTE] over [UPPER ARCHITECTURAL FEATURE] thinning to bare line at the crown. Diagonal light shafts left as reserved white paper, the brightest value. Floor in [FLOOR COLOR / WASH] with a backrun. Figures in three depth bands, clustered and gapped, never in a row: [NEAR FIGURES AND SCALE], one cropped by the bottom edge; [MID FIGURES AND SCALE] scattered at different distances, [MIDGROUND CLUSTER] clustered at [FOCAL POINT]; [FAR FIGURES AND SCALE] dissolving into strokes. Different actions each — [ACTION 1], [ACTION 2], [ACTION 3]
